field.label: The field, with {{units}} units, {{selected}} selected and {{shapes}} walls and obstacles. The unit list and the list of walls and obstacles below the field carry the same state as text.

rail.title: Tools
rail.failed: The catalog could not be read, so no tools are available.

inspector.faces: Give it to {{count}}; {{transform}} in {{scenes}}; watch {{observable}}; measure {{metrics}}.
inspector.twoLevel: it forms up around an anchor
inspector.fixed: it forms up on a leader
inspector.previewQuiet: Nothing fires yet: no unit would change course.
inspector.previewArrows: {{units}} units would change course, the strongest pull {{strongest}}. The faint arrows on the field show each one.
inspector.costTravel: It multiplies the cost of every step by {{weight}}. A weight on every step alike makes no ground dearer than any other: it changes how far the search trusts its heuristic, so above one it expands more cells for the same route, and below one it expands fewer and may take a different route.
inspector.costLayers: Its other weights weigh danger, visibility, exposure and cover, which are the same everywhere on this field until an influence map gives it a layer, so they change nothing yet.
inspector.costLayersOnly: Its weights weigh danger, exposure and cover, which are the same everywhere on this field until an influence map gives it a layer, so the route, its length and its expansions stay as they are.
inspector.routeNoObjective: Set an objective, and each unit finds its way to it.
inspector.routeFound: With a route: {{count}}, {{length}} long on average.
inspector.routeSearch: The search for {{unit}} expanded {{expansions}} cells; its next waypoint is at {{waypoint}}.
inspector.routeSearchEmpty: The search for {{unit}} expanded {{expansions}} cells and found no way.
inspector.showSearch: Show search: shade the cells the last search expanded and its frontier
inspector.noPath: No route ({{count}}): walls seal the objective off, so each stops where it stands.
inspector.unreachableGoal: No route ({{count}}): the objective is too close to a wall or an obstacle for a unit to stand there.
inspector.unreachableStart: No route ({{count}}): each is hemmed in where it stands, with no cell it can walk to.
inspector.slotCaption: The slots this would fill, hardest to place first. Total cost {{cost}}.
inspector.slotCaptionLive: {{placed}} of {{total}} units are in their slots, hardest to place first. Total cost {{cost}}.
inspector.issueEmpty: Select units on the field first.
inspector.issueObjective: Click the field to set an objective first.
inspector.chooseTool: {{count}} selected. Choose a tool from the rail.
inspector.selectFirst: Drag round some units, then choose a tool from the rail.
inspector.refused: The scene engine does not run {{kind}}, so this step was refused and nothing changed.
inspector.refusedNoUnits: {{kind}} needs units that are in this scene, so this step was refused and nothing changed.
inspector.formation: Formation: anchor {{anchor}} from the members’ mean, slot error {{slot}}, assignment cost {{cost}}.
inspector.awaitingRun: Applied. Press Play or Step to run it.
inspector.live: Live: changes here reach these units as you make them.
inspector.fire: it sends a shot across the field
inspector.projectile: it changes how shots cross the field
inspector.targetHint: Choose a unit here or click its glyph on the field.
inspector.tempoBands: Below 24 plays four beats, 24 to below 60 plays three, and 60 or more plays two.
inspector.fireDefinition: Mark a glyph or the objective. The selected pieces send streaks across the board in their role colours.
inspector.streakDefinition: Set the speed of a streak. Drag slows an unassisted shot and stretches the animation of an assisted one.
inspector.singleDefinition: Pick one pose from the marked piece’s animation. The streak meets that pose on its original beat. Drag delays its arrival.
inspector.repeatDefinition: Read later poses as drag stretches the streak. The Later cues control limits how far along the animation this tool can look.
inspector.shotNoTarget: Choose a target or place the objective on the field.
inspector.aim: it reads a pose from the board animation
inspector.clipLength: Planned clip · {{time}} s ({{end}} frames). Contact or range can end it early.
inspector.poseBeyondRange: The streak reaches its range limit before the marked pose.

notice.unknownTool: No tool in the catalog has the id {{id}}, so no tool is chosen.
notice.untypedTool: {{title}} has no typed transform yet, so the scene cannot run it and no tool is chosen.
notice.refusedTool: {{title}} is {{kind}}, which the scene engine does not run, so no tool is chosen.
notice.catalogUnavailable: The catalog could not be read, so the tool {{id}} could not be looked up and no tool is chosen.
notice.importFailed: That text is not a composition, so nothing was imported.
notice.saveFailed: This browser would not store that, so the composition is listed here but will not be here after a reload.
notice.storedIgnored: A saved scene in this browser could not be read, so it was ignored and left as it is. Saving will replace it.

coach.tool: Pick a tool on the right. Flocking is a good first one.
coach.send: Right-click open ground to send them.
coach.sendTouch: Tap open ground, then choose Arrive.
coach.form: Now select the others and try a wedge.
coach.tune: Drag a slider while they move. Then press Compare to watch the timelines part.
coach.wall: Press, drag and release on the field to draw a wall. Hold Shift to keep it straight across or straight down.
coach.obstacle: Click the field to place an obstacle, or press and drag to choose how wide it is.
